description:
Scryber is an advanced PDF generation engine based around HTML templates with CSS styles and SVG drawing. It includes full flowing pages, dynamic template binding on your object model and referenced external files, images, css and fonts. 
Easily create documents from your Apps, MVC sites, or Javascipt ajax calls.

This framework is built entirely in .NET supporting Blazor WASM and is released under the LGPL licence so you can use to it in commercial applications.
releaseNotes: 9.7.4 Fixed a data race in PDFFontWidths (font glyph registration) that could corrupt concurrently-rendered documents' text under multi-threaded rendering, sometimes silently writing wrong glyphs with no exception raised. Contributed by twofatmonkeys (PR #186). Updated the Scryber.Core.OpenType dependency to 9.7.4, fixing a companion data race in TTFStringMeasurer's glyph metric cache under the same multi-threaded rendering conditions. Neither fix alone makes concurrent rendering safe - both are required. 9.7.3 Fixed a display:table container (e.g. a designer-authored figure wrapping an image) silently dropping any loose non table-row/table-cell child from layout, including never registering it as a PDF image resource. 9.7.2 Fixed :nth-child/:nth-of-type not correctly counting siblings across an IInvisibleContainer wrapper (e.g. {{#each}}-generated content), which previously made every generated item compute itself as an isolated "1 of 1". Fixed flex row items requiring a Panel-derived component - non-container children (e.g. bare text nodes) are now wrapped in a new InvisibleFlexContainer so they get a proper block-layout box. Fixed an XML/HTML parser bug where an element immediately (no whitespace) after {{/each}} could be silently dropped from the component tree when it shared its outer container's tag name. 9.7.0 BREAKING CHANGE: / already accepted integer pixels only (from 9.6.0.7-beta); now correctly documented as a breaking change for this major version bump. Added CSS aspect-ratio support for images and block elements. Added colgroup/col table column support with width, background-color, and span. Added CSS grid: grid-template-areas, grid-area, named grid lines, auto-fill/auto-fit in repeat(), grid-auto-columns/rows, justify-content and align-content. Added flex align-items for column-direction flex containers. Added CSS var()/calc() support in flex and grid CSS properties. Fixed SVG image min/max-width/height sizing across all four sizing strategies, with correct aspect-ratio preservation. Fixed SVG image 300x150 clipping bug for unsized SVG images (canvas now sized from page). Fixed page-break-after followed by page-break-before producing a redundant blank page. Fixed CSS var()/calc() silent failures (no longer drops entire style block on unbound expressions). Various flex, grid, list, font, and layout bug fixes. 9.6.0.14-beta Fixed a defect in PDFFontDefinition (GitHub issue #183) where the bfrange table's glyph offset array was sized by the count of registered characters rather than the count of glyph offsets, producing incorrect font width/ToUnicode output for composite and OpenType fonts. Fixed a CSS parsing defect where a var()/calc() expression on certain properties (e.g. column-gap) could throw during premature evaluation, silently discarding the entire enclosing CSS style block - including every other property already parsed in it. Added var()/calc() expression support to the Flex and Grid CSS property parsers (flex-direction, flex-wrap, justify-content, align-items/content/self, flex-grow/shrink/basis, order, gap, row-gap, grid-column/row (and start/end), grid-template-columns/rows, grid-auto-columns/rows, grid-auto-flow, and named grid-area), so these properties can now be driven by CSS custom properties and calc() expressions. 9.6.0.13-beta CSS grid auto-fill/auto-fit: repeat(auto-fill, size) and repeat(auto-fit, size) now compute the column count from the container width at layout time. When no explicit width is set on the grid container, the count is resolved from the parent engine's available block width. Grid containers without an explicit CSS width now render as block-level boxes, filling the full parent available width (matching browser behaviour), including on overflow/continuation pages. CSS grid explicit placement with auto-fill: grid-column/grid-row explicit placements now work correctly when auto-fill tracks are used. 9.6.0.12-beta CSS grid row-span and row-gap border rendering: grid cells now fill their spanning row height via a post-layout stretch pass. The inner grid-item block is updated to the cell block's final height minus the top margin (row-gap), preventing items overflowing into the gap area and causing missing borders on rows 2+. CSS grid explicit placement: fixed gap/column-gap cascade so both shorthand and longhand properties are respected in the correct CSS order. Column-gap visual spacing is now injected as left margin on non-first-column cells so cells render in the correct position. Added Grid_21 through Grid_29 unit tests covering line-based placement, grid-column/grid-row, grid-area with spans, and row-spanning cells. flex-direction:column: added justify-content support for column-direction flex containers; fixed align-items when an explicit height is set on the container. flex align-items: added support for align-items (flex-start, flex-end, center, stretch, baseline) on flex containers; fixed overflow when the container has multiple columns. flex layout in multi-column parents: fixed containerW calculation so percentage-width flex items resolve against the actual flex container width rather than the page width when the container is inside a multi-column layout. flex wrap fixes: fixed CSS class-based border suppression (was checking BorderItemKey instead of BorderStyleKey); fixed ghost blank rows and blank pages when flex wrap produces a partial last row; fixed CSS percentage padding/margin axis resolution in wrapped flex rows. 9.6.0.11-beta Fixed flex layout percentage-width items being re-resolved against the page width (instead of the flex container) when a child block opened its layout options. Explicit percentage or absolute widths are now correctly pinned to the flex algorithm's container-relative resolved value. Grow-only items (no explicit width) continue to use fill-width behaviour so their padding/border stays within column bounds. Fixed flex wrap row-breaking with percentage item widths: GetItemMinWidth previously returned the raw number from a Unit (e.g. 45 for 45%) instead of resolving it against the container, causing all items to appear to fit in one row regardless of their actual pt widths. Added Flex_61, Flex_62, Flex_63, Flex_64 layout unit tests covering: flex-grow distribution, explicit fixed widths with no grow, percentage widths resolved against the flex container, and 3-row wrap layout with 45%+100%+45% items. 9.6.0.10-beta Pre-load header/footer template components during the DataBind phase so that remote image requests in headers and footers are registered before Layout runs. In WASM (and other async-only environments) there is no synchronous HTTP fallback, so images whose requests are only registered at Layout time are never fulfilled. Fixed HasAdornments to check the template properties directly instead of the post-bind list (which was always empty, preventing the fix from running). Removed the now-unnecessary LayoutEngineHTMLBody override. 9.6.0.9-beta Fixed flex layout bug where min-height on a flex item caused its width to be inflated by the item's left margin (double-margin application in EnsureContentsFit when SetContentSize was called after Close). Fixed flex-grow, flex-shrink and flex-basis set via CSS class rules (not inline style) being ignored in ComputeColumnWidths — now uses the full computed style via GetAppliedStyle + StyleStack + BuildFullStyle so CSS class-driven flex sizing works correctly. 9.6.0.8-beta Added support for the CSS aspect-ratio property (e.g. aspect-ratio: 16/9), including deriving it from an element's width/height attributes as a natural-size hint. When CSS explicitly sets only one of width/height, the other dimension is now derived from the aspect-ratio (explicit CSS or intrinsic attributes) instead of being forced to a literal pixel size that could fight the styled dimension and distort the image. Applies to both raster and SVG image sizing. 9.6.0.7-beta BREAKING CHANGE: / attributes now match the HTML5 spec - they set the image's intrinsic pixel size (a plain non-negative integer) instead of accepting arbitrary CSS units directly. A bare width="50%" or width="40pt" attribute on will now throw a parse exception; move percentage or point-based sizing into style="width:...; height:..." instead. Also added a style attribute mapping to /. 9.6.0.6-beta Fixed LayoutEngineFlexGrid column widths for spanned cells - a cell spanning multiple grid columns now sums the widths of all the tracks it spans, instead of only receiving a single track's width. 9.6.0.5-beta Added full support for HTML table colgroup/col elements - column width, background, alignment and class styles now apply per-column to matching cells in the table layout engine, without overwriting a cell's own explicit style. Fixed the col/colgroup span calculation (a span of N now covers exactly N columns). Added CSS grid-column/grid-row parsing and span support, flexbox align-self and order properties, the flex-shrink algorithm for overflowing flex rows, and the CSS anonymous box algorithm for display:table/table-row/table-cell content that isn't explicitly wrapped. Fixed legacy handling for values pasted from Apple Pages. 9.6.0.4-beta Fixed an infinite pagination/stack overflow bug where a page-break request (e.g. break-after: always) originating from within a page header or footer's own content would repeatedly regenerate new pages without end. Header/footer content can no longer trigger page breaks. 9.6.0.3-beta Rolled back Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration/Logging dependencies to 8.x - the 10.x versions introduced in 9.6.0.2-beta pulled in a .NET 10 requirement that broke WASM compatibility. 9.6.0.2-beta Added support for asynchronous document and component parsing 9.6.0.1-beta NEW: Added support for display flex layout. NEW: Added support for display grid layout NEW: Added support for table-x layout NEW: Added support for z-index rendering NEW: Added support for column balancing Added jQuery-esque FindMatches with CSS selectors and support chained queries. Added updates to support to preserve meta-* and data-* attributes (PR #173 Damir Liask) Added fallback to model and values if property is not found (PR #173 Damir Liask) Improved data-url resiliance for parsing and case in-sensitivity (PR #173 Damir Liask) Improved config options changing to a list rather than array and allowing coded updates Fixed an issue with with multiple returns Fixed issue with CSS var default values being treated as properties Fixed issue with display grid layout for and cascading CSS Fixed issue with floats after balanced columns 9.5.0.1 BREAKING RELEASE Removed support for Net Standard 2.0, and Image Sharp updated to 3.1.2 All libraries updated to include dotnet 8/9/10 Added support image format webP Improved support for referenced SVG img Clean up codebase to remove compiler warnings 9.3.1.0 Fixes for break-before/after to take proiority over page-break-before Fixes for @page to support margins, along with :first, :left and :right pseudo classes 9.3.0.0 CSS updates for rowspan on table cells, column-rules, contain on background images, border-radius on individual corners and CSS variables can now be modified in document properties. Fixed page sizing in groups with fallback on following pages, whitespace hadling in soft returns, and SVG img placement and sizing. Added *initial* implementation for flex-box, flex-grid, and table-xxx display Configuration improvements incuding cusom image factories and custom expression functions. 9.2.0.3 Fixed styling issue when components are hidden using css. 9.2.0.2 Fixed repeating raster background images with cover size 9.2.0.1 Added support for repeating SVG background images from Data urls 9.2.0.0 Public release will all added features from the betas. Too many to list, but consult the documentation here https://www.paperworkday.info/learning/ and the refererence section here https://www.paperworkday.info/reference/ 9.1.2-rc.5/6 Couple of fixes for overflowing tables in a kept together parent, and svg font-weight bold and light are now supported and fixed an issue with the reverse function. 9.1.2-rc.4 Working modification of PDFs and templates using framesets and frames and support for SVG background images with opacity. 9.1.0.7-beta First release of framesets for trimming and merging documents. Also hiding variables that do not have any content. 9.0.0.1-rc.3 Added extra html entity values to match available sources. 9.0.0.1-rc.2 Fixes for template parsing and added data-content to the template element, plus minor fixes and unit test updates. Second release candidate. 9.0.0.1-rc.1 Minor fixes for layout. First release candidate. 9.0.0.1-beta Fixed a minor layout issue with multiple footer elementnamed components being applite to a page footer, and also header. 9.0.0.0-beta Completely updated version for .NET 9.0 with support for html, css, svg and binding in a WASM compatible package with remote asset and content requests. NOTE: If upgrading, PLEASE CHECK THE OUTPUT of your documents before releasing. See: https://paperwork.help/changelog/scryber_core.html for a full break down.
